answer: A farm faces 5 letters of reference, each one priced at £68 for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One name, one proof, one entry: Clothbound dye guild beadle tenter charter enforces it, and a charter dye guild beadles hold after dyehouse checks is how the check runs. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The lagoon is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps timber. One relic, one entry.
